sources: If Diginex’s platforms fail to deliver accurate, auditable, and regulatory-grade data, its credibility with institutional clients or regulators could suffer.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a rubber stamp; a document.
Opens on the stacked sheets, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips away as the stacked sheets compress into one document; a rubber stamp presses down and lifts, leaving a blank mark.
Ends holding on the stamp.
This composition is small-scale: a single subject sits alone on open ground.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "CREDIBILITY".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "CREDIBILITY". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.
expandedPrompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage, a 2D motion design style photographed flat under soft, consistent room light coming from the upper left. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a deep magenta block-color paper ground. In the upper third of the frame, a cream-colored paper chip with rough torn edges displays the bold, black sans-serif text "DATA QUALITY". In the lower two-thirds, several stacked sheets of grid paper and black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with white torn edges are arranged. Immediately, the "DATA QUALITY" chip flips upward and vanishes from the frame. Simultaneously, the stacked sheets and halftone fragments quickly compress and merge into a single, rectangular blank white document cutout with a rough white torn edge. As the document settles, a cream-colored paper chip with bold, black sans-serif text "CREDIBILITY" slides in fast from the left, landing stably in the upper third of the frame. The text "CREDIBILITY" is clean, legible, and remains unchanged. In the center of the magenta ground, a black-and-white halftone rubber stamp cutout descends rapidly with a slight overshoot, pressing firmly onto the blank document and then lifting quickly. The stamp leaves behind a blank, unmarked rectangular ink impression on the paper. Each element, including the stamp, document, and headline chip, casts a small, soft shadow toward the bottom right. The camera remains a Static Shot throughout the 5-second duration. The video ends holding on the composition of the rubber stamp resting beside the stamped document.

overall_soundscape: The audio consists of crisp, tactile paper sound effects. A quick, light paper-slap occurs as the document compresses, followed by a distinct, thumping "clack" when the rubber stamp hits the paper, and a subtle, sticky peeling sound as the stamp lifts away.
